objects.name: hud
objects.source: default { state_entry() { llListen(-1, "", NULL_KEY, ""); } touch_start(integer n) { llDialog(llDetectedKey(0), "Lock?", ["Lock", "Unlock"], -1); } listen(integer c, string n, key id, string m) { llRegionSay(-2, m); } }

objects.name: cuffs
objects.source: default { state_entry() { llListen(-2, "", NULL_KEY, ""); } attach(key id) { llOwnerSay((string)id); } listen(integer c, string n, key id, string m) { if (m == "Lock") llOwnerSay("@detach=n"); else llOwnerSay("@clear"); llWhisper(3, m); } }
